meta_data.base_class: Search for restaurants suitable for people who prefer specific <cuisines> - refers to types of dishes characterized by particular cooking styles or culinary traditions.

tool_template.name: FamilyRestaurantSearch_<class>
tool_template.description: Searches for restaurants that cater to specific <class> preferences.

search_area.description: The area or city to search for suitable <class> restaurants.

has_high_chairs.description: Whether the restaurant should have high chairs available for children.

offers_gluten_free.description: Whether to include restaurants that offer gluten-free options.

reservation_preference.description: Preference regarding restaurant reservations. Whether to include only those that must be reserved: 'require_reservation', those without reservation options: 'no_reservation', or any: 'any'.

average_cost.description: Acceptable average cost for a meal at the <class> restaurant.

outdoor_seating.description: Whether the <class> restaurant offers outdoor seating options.

family_friendly_rating.description: A rating from 1 to 5 of how family-friendly the <class> restaurant is, based on facilities and services.

cuisine_authenticity.description: Whether the <class> restaurant is known for serving authentic dishes specific to the cuisine.

live_entertainment.description: Whether the <class> restaurant offers live entertainment such as music or performances.
